experiment.claim: Issue #22 -- NOT a spec claim (spec/target-spec.md does not exist yet, spec/porting-plan.md Sec4 item 4). Substantiates that temp_core reaches its intended operating branch (PTAT/CTAT tracking their design/temp_core.md-documented shape, positive supply current) from a physical 0 V cold start at every point of the full 45-point PVT matrix, with EN tied high through the entire power-up ramp. This is the temp_core counterpart to sim/bias-core-startup/ (issue #19): design/temp_core.md's previous 'verification done' section recorded only a cold-.op spot check of the same class issue #19 retired for bias_core (ngspice's continuation on a self-biased DeltaVBE cell can land on a non-physical branch, and which points those are changes when only the linear solver changes) -- temp_core has never been run over a full PVT grid at all before this experiment. EN's own axis (asserted for the whole ramp vs. released only after the supply is up) is exercised separately by sim/temp-core-startup-en-delayed/, the DR-002 startup ordering temp_core will actually see.
experiment.statistical_convention: N/A (corner-matrix check, not a distribution claim)
experiment.title: temp_core cold-start branch selection (EN high through the whole ramp): transient supply ramp from 0 V across the full PVT matrix

spread_checks.note: Corner-blindness guard, same convention as sim/bias-core-startup/'s own vref spread check: if every corner returns the same settled PTAT, the .lib/.temp injection is not taking effect. PTAT is PTAT-by-construction (design/temp_core.md), so its spread across a -40..125 C matrix should be well above this floor.
